## Goal

Replace the offline-only request handling with an async router that serves the live
Wikimedia image same-origin, so the client can read its pixels on a canvas.

## Scope

- `src/proxy.ts`: `export function isAllowedImageUrl(raw: string): boolean` is true only for protocol `https:`, hostname exactly `upload.wikimedia.org`, empty username, password and port.
- `src/router.ts`:
  - `export type RouterReply = { status: number; type: string; body: string | Uint8Array }`.
  - `export type Deps = { fetchDay(date: string): Promise<DayImage | null>; fetchImage(url: string): Promise<{ type: string; bytes: Uint8Array } | null>; today(): string }`.
  - `export async function dispatch(method: string, url: string, deps: Deps): Promise<RouterReply>` with these routes:
    - `GET /` returns an HTML shell with elements `img#art`, `#date`, `#title`, `#story`, `#credit`, `<link rel="stylesheet" href="/client/style.css">` and `<script type="module" src="/client/main.ts">`.
    - `GET /api/today[?date=YYYY-MM-DD]` returns JSON `{ date, title, story, credit, licence, source, image }`. When `deps.fetchDay` returns `null`, the fields come from `offlineImage(date)` in `src/server.ts`.
    - `GET /offline.svg?date=` returns `offlineImage(date).svg` as `image/svg+xml`.
    - `GET /img?u=<url>` returns 403 unless `isAllowedImageUrl(u)`, 502 when `deps.fetchImage` returns `null`, and otherwise the bytes with the upstream content type and `cache-control: public, max-age=86400` semantics recorded in `type` handling.
    - `GET /client/<name>.ts` and `GET /shared/<name>.ts` read from `src/client` and `src/shared`, strip types with `stripTypeScriptTypes` from `node:module`, cache the result in a `Map`, and reply as `text/javascript`. `<name>` must match `/^[a-z0-9-]+$/`. `GET /client/style.css` is served as `text/css`.
    - Any other path returns 404 and any non-GET method returns 405.
- `src/server.ts`: `createServer` awaits `dispatch` with real deps (`fetchDay` from `src/feed.ts`, and a `fetchImage` using global `fetch` with a 10000 ms timeout). `route` and `offlineImage` stay exported with their current behaviour.

## Out of scope

- Client code and CSS content (W1-04). Missing client files give 404, not a crash.

## Done

- `node --test tests/router.test.ts tests/proxy.test.ts` passes with the five tests in the header, using stub deps and no network calls.
- `tests/slice.test.ts` still passes unchanged.
- `node src/server.ts` logs the listening URL, and `GET /api/today` answers 200 both with and without network access.
